Title: Trainer Panel
修改器
PhaseNotice: Development preview. Save before testing; in-game acceptance is pending.
开发测试版：请先保存。已编译的功能仍需实机与存读档验证。
PersonnelHelp: Create a new, unique staff member through the game's personnel generator. Identity, appearance, skill and HQ roster use the normal reward flow.
通过游戏自身流程生成全新且唯一的人员，自动设置合法身份、外观和技能等级，并加入复仇者号人员名单。
HealingCount: 可完成的士兵治疗项目
HealingHelp: Complete normal healing projects for living, uncaptured soldiers in the HQ roster. Restores HP and clears wounds. The original game may also raise Will to the Ready threshold and resume paused Psi training. Dead/captured units and units without a legal healing project are excluded.
完成兵营中存活、未被俘士兵的正常治疗项目，恢复生命并解除伤势。按原版规则，可能将意志恢复至就绪下限，并恢复暂停的灵能训练。死亡、被俘或没有合法治疗项目的单位不会被处理。
NothingToHeal: 当前没有符合条件的士兵治疗项目。
InvalidNumber: Enter an integer from 0 to 2147483647. Negative, decimal and overflowing values are rejected.
请输入 0 至 2147483647 的整数；不接受负数、小数或超出范围的值。
Unavailable: This action is only available in an active single-player strategy campaign.
此操作仅在已载入的单机战略战役中可用。
Stale: The game state changed. Nothing new was applied; refresh and confirm again.
游戏状态已变化，本次未继续提交。请刷新后重新确认。
SubmitFailed: 游戏未接受本次状态提交。
VerifyFailed: Post-submit verification did not match. Check the game and Launch.log before repeating this operation.
提交后的数据与预期不符。请检查游戏和 Launch.log，再决定是否重试。
MissingResource: The resource entry is missing from HQ inventory. No change was submitted.
HQ 库存缺少此资源条目，本次未提交修改。
SaveReminder: This operation may change campaign state. Save beforehand.
该操作可能改变战役状态，建议提前保存。
FullHeal: 完全治疗 / 清除伤势
RestoreWill: 恢复意志 / 解除疲劳
SoldierHelp: Values are base stats. HP/Mobility/Will: 1-1000; other stats: 0-1000; AP: 0-100000. Template defaults exclude rank bonuses. Heal wounds and restore Will before changing their maximums. XP follows the game's cap; WOTC normally promotes by kills.
显示基础属性：生命/移动/意志为 1–1000，其余属性为 0–1000；AP 为 0–100000。模板默认值不包含军衔加成。修改生命/意志上限前先治疗/恢复意志。XP 遵循原版上限；WOTC 通常按击杀晋升。
SpawnHelp: Click class/rank to cycle; click quantity to enter 1-20. Rookies have no class; named classes start at Squaddie. Faction soldiers require a contacted faction. High ranks use sequential promotions; choose advanced abilities in the normal Armory.
点击职业/军衔循环选择，点击数量输入 1–20。新兵尚未分配职业；指定职业最低列兵。派系士兵要求已接触对应派系。高军衔通过原版逻辑逐级晋升，高阶技能请到原版军械库选择。
UnsafeDemote: Demotion and changing an already-promoted soldier's class are disabled: the SDK debug reset does not reconcile spent WOTC AP and all persistent abilities. A rookie may choose one of the four standard classes during promotion.
降级与已晋升士兵转职已禁用：SDK 调试重置流程未完整处理 WOTC 已花费 AP 与持久能力。新兵可在晋升时选择四种普通职业。
Unsafe: This feature is unsafe in this version and has been disabled.
该功能当前版本不安全，已禁用。
SelectSoldierFirst: Open a soldier in the soldier editor, then choose Rank / rookie class.
请先在士兵编辑器选择士兵，再点击“军衔 / 新兵职业”。
Bounds: The value is outside this control's permitted range.
数值超出该控件允许范围，请检查说明。
Unsupported: The current game templates do not support this operation safely.
当前游戏模板不支持安全执行此操作。
FactionLocked: Contact this resistance faction before adding its soldiers.
请先在战役中接触对应抵抗派系，再添加该派系士兵。
UnitUnavailable: Read only: select a living, uncaptured HQ soldier who is Active or Healing and not on a covert action.
只读：仅可修改兵营中存活、未被俘、处于待命或治疗中且未执行秘密行动的士兵。
HealFirst: Complete this soldier's normal healing project before editing maximum HP.
请先完成该士兵的正常治疗项目，再修改生命上限。
WillFirst: Restore Will first so its recovery project remains synchronized.
请先恢复意志，再修改意志上限，以保持恢复项目同步。
XPCap: XP exceeds the current original-game promotion cap, or this rank has no safe AddXp path. Use sequential promotion instead.
XP 超出原版当前晋升上限，或此军衔的 AddXp 路径不能安全使用。请使用逐级晋升。
NoWillProject: No legal Will recovery project exists for this soldier; no change was submitted.
该士兵没有合法的意志恢复项目，本次未提交修改。
TacticalHelp: Current mission only; XCOM soldiers only. Hit/Crit applies to StandardAim attacks. Healing does not clear status effects or post-mission wounds. Restore cooldowns counts abilities on cooldown. Ammo/No Reload share automatic refill behavior.
仅限当前任务的 XCOM 士兵。命中/暴击针对标准命中判定攻击。回血不清除异常状态或战后伤势。重置冷却显示冷却中技能数量。无限弹药与无需装填均自动补满弹匣。
TacticalUnavailable: Available during an idle XCOM turn in single-player tactical combat; select a living XCOM soldier.
仅在单机战术的 XCOM 行动阶段可用；请选中存活的 XCOM 士兵并等待当前动作结束。
TacticalToggles[8]: 无限技能 / 物品充能
MissionControl: 任务控制 / 修复诊断
ObjectiveHelp: Left: actual mission records (internal IDs). Right: localized HUD objectives. The SDK does not expose a reliable mapping between these lists. Completing a record does not bypass each mission's scripted conditions.
左侧为实际任务记录（内部 ID），右侧为中文 HUD 目标。SDK 没有提供两者可靠的逐项映射。完成记录不会自动绕过各任务的脚本条件。
PendingSubmission: 正在进行潜在状态提交
NoEnemiesHint: No living Alien/Lost units. Check unresolved Sweep objectives and pending reinforcements; this alone does not prove a mission bug.
未发现存活异形或失魂者。可检查未完成的 Sweep 目标与待增援；仅此不能判定任务故障。
SkipAI: 跳过当前 AI 回合…
MissionLimits: AI skip cannot interrupt an in-flight state submission. Same-seed restart and forced evacuation remain disabled until an auditable API exists.
跳过 AI 无法中断正在提交的状态。同种子重开与强制全队撤离在找到可审计 API 前仍然禁用。
HUDObjectives: 中文 HUD 目标状态
SkipAIHelp: Current enemy player: active turn -> skip requested. Uses the normal SkipTurn state context. This may resolve some AI stalls, but not animation or latent-submission hangs.
当前敌方玩家：行动中 → 请求跳过回合。使用原版 SkipTurn 状态流程，可用于部分 AI 卡顿；无法处理动画或潜在状态提交卡死。
RestartHelp: Current mission progress -> original mission restart. Unsaved tactical progress is lost. Disabled for Ironman and tutorials. The same random seed is not guaranteed.
当前任务进度 → 原版重开任务。未保存的战术进度会丢失。铁人和教程中禁用；不保证随机种子相同。
EndMissionHelp: Completing all records may affect strategy rewards. Victory uses normal EndBattle and first requires the mission's own success conditions. It does not rescue/copy units or fake campaign success. Failure also uses the normal end-game state.
完成全部记录可能影响战役奖励。胜利结束使用原版 EndBattle，且必须先满足任务自身成功条件；不会伪造营救或战役成功。失败结束也使用正常结束状态。
CompleteAll: 完成全部未完成目标记录…
AIBusy: No AI-controlled UnitActions turn is currently available to skip. Wait for pending state submissions to finish.
当前没有可跳过的 AI 行动阶段。请等待状态提交完成。
CompleteFirst: The mission's original success conditions are not met. Inspect actual objectives, VIP/rescue and other scenario requirements first.
尚未满足任务的原版成功条件。请先检查实际任务目标、VIP/营救及其他场景要求。
NoObjectives: No eligible incomplete objective was selected.
未选中可完成的任务目标记录。
RepairAI: 禁用 AI 行动规划…
RestoreAI: 恢复 AI 行动规划…
AIHangHelp: Sets the AI players' skip flag, the same switch the original SkipAI console command and the SeqAct_SkipAI Kismet node use. A stalled AI player then finishes its turn through the engine's own end-turn path instead of being force-reset.
设置 AI 玩家的跳过标志，与原版 SkipAI 控制台命令及 SeqAct_SkipAI 关卡节点使用同一开关。停滞的 AI 玩家会通过引擎自身的结束回合流程结束回合，而不是被强制重置。
AIHangNote: Transient state: not saved, not part of game state. Objectives and units are not modified. Reloading the mission clears it.
仅为临时状态：不会保存，不属于 GameState。不会修改任务目标与单位。重新载入任务后复位。
RoleNone: This mission has no tactical or strategy objectives configured.
本任务未配置战术或战略目标。
VictoryReady: Mission success conditions are satisfied; the campaign will record a success.
任务成功条件已满足；战役将记录为成功。
VictoryBlockedBy: Campaign success is not satisfied yet:
战役成功条件尚未满足：
SweepNote: Vanilla rule: mission cleanup recovers dead soldiers' bodies and sweeps loot only when every tactical objective is complete. Completing the missing objectives first restores that resolution.
原版规则：只有当所有战术目标完成后，任务结算才会回收阵亡士兵遗体并清扫战利品。先补齐缺失的目标即可恢复该结算。
LootSweepBlocked: Sweep not resolved: bodies and loot will NOT be recovered.
清扫未结算：阵亡遗体与战利品不会被回收。
SameSeedWhy: Disabled: the original RestartLevelWithSameSeed also calls XComCheatManager.SetSeedOverride, a native function with no readable implementation. Without that step a restart cannot be proven to reuse the same seed, so it is not offered.
已禁用：原版 RestartLevelWithSameSeed 还会调用 XComCheatManager.SetSeedOverride，该函数为 native 实现、无源码可核对。缺少这一步无法证明复用了同一随机种子，因此不提供该功能。
ItemHelp: Weapons, armor, ammo, upgrades and combat sims are enumerated live from the game's own item template manager, so everything the current game defines (DLC and installed mods included) appears here. Pick a row, set the amount and confirm to add it to the Avenger inventory.
武器、护甲、弹药、改装件与战斗芯片全部实时枚举自游戏自身的物品模板表，因此当前游戏定义的一切（含 DLC 与已安装的 Mod）都会出现在这里。选中一行、设定数量并确认，即可加入复仇者号仓库。
ItemExcludedWhy: templates that are resources, schematics, mission or story items, unlimited items, or carry no display name. Those are handled by the resource page or granted by campaign progress, so adding them here would duplicate or derail the campaign.
属于资源、图纸、任务或剧情物品、无限物品，以及没有显示名称的模板。它们由资源页处理，或由战役进度发放；从这里加入会重复发放或破坏剧情流程。
ItemEmpty: Select an item to see its details.
选择一件物品以查看详情。
GrantHelp: This uses the same inventory path as an instant item build: no cost is charged and no build time is spent. The granted template is always the one selected here; the trainer does not substitute an upgraded version. Save before testing.
此操作与原版“瞬间建造完成”使用同一条入库流程：不消耗资源，也不占用建造时间。发放的模板始终是这里选中的那一件，修改器不会替换成升级版本。测试前请先存档。
UniqueNote: This item is always stored as a unique object, so one copy is added per confirmation.
此物品始终以独立对象存放，因此每次确认只加入 1 件。
NotGrantable: The trainer does not offer this template; see the notice text.
修改器不提供此模板，请见说明文字。
